_comment: Copy to ~/.config/magpie/config.json and fill in. ghPath/jiraPath are optional; if omitted the app probes ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, /usr/bin. Omit the whole 'jira' block to run GitHub-only.

github._comment: Optional repo/org filter. Patterns match 'owner', 'owner/*', or 'owner/repo' (case-insensitive). 'exclude' hides repos; 'include' rescues specific repos from a broader exclude (include wins). Example below hides all of some-org except some-org/keep-this. Omit the block to show everything.

jira.jql: (assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done) OR (watcher = currentUser() AND updated >= -7d) OR (reporter = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done)
